content.what_it_is: SEDIMENT_MODULE is the SEDIMENT-guarded FUNWAVE sediment and morphology implementation (L54-L1677). It reads cohesive/noncohesive sediment controls and defaults (L153-L775), allocates and initializes concentration, pickup/deposition, bed-load, bed-change, mask, and diagnostic fields (L843-L925), derives grain/critical-stress/settling quantities and loads an optional hard-bottom surface (L927-L984), advances depth-integrated concentration CHH with upwind or weighted advection plus shear-dependent diffusion and pickup/deposition sources (L990-L1439), imposes closed scalar-flux boundaries (L1443-L1517), and accumulates suspended/bed-load morphology, optional avalanching, depth update, halo exchange, and staggered depth reconstruction (L1519-L1670).

verbatim_spans.text: !  SEDIMENT is a module to model sediment transport and morpho changes

unresolved: Use of a stale or undefined shear velocity in y diffusion: ustar_c is assigned only inside the preceding x-face loop and only when MASK(I,J)>0 (L1123-L1158), but the separate y-face loop never recomputes it and combines that residual scalar with cell-specific ustar_c4 in k4 (L1163-L1177). Thus every y-face can use the last qualifying x-loop cell's value, or an undefined value if no qualifying x cell ran.

Tau_xy has no initialization after allocation (L867-L925) and is assigned only where MASK>0 and H>MinDepthPickup (L1244-L1256). The later deposition loop spans Ibeg:Iend+1 and Jbeg:Jend+1 and, for every MASK>0 cohesive cell, reads Tau_xy in Pd (L1355-L1364). Shallow wet cells and wet halo cells can therefore read Tau_xy before assignment; no Tau_xy halo exchange appears between these regions.

Cohesive deposition probability is not bounded below: Pd becomes negative when Tau_xy exceeds Tau_crd_coh (L1363), and D is then assigned WS*CH*Pd without MAX(0,...) (L1364). Because the transport source is Pickup-D (L1208), negative deposition acts as an additional positive concentration source.

Avalanche transfers are stored with scalar assignment rather than accumulation: each steep cell writes both its own and one neighbor's Zb_avalanching entry (L1585-L1627). Later loop iterations can overwrite earlier incoming/outgoing transfers to the same cell before the one-shot bed update at L1633-L1634, making the result loop-order dependent and losing superposed transfers.
